questions.question: When Israel's people came to David at Hebron, what did they say the LORD told David he would be for Israel?
When David marched to Jerusalem, the people of Jebus kept him out of the fortress of Zion. True or false?
When David attacked the Jebusites, what did he say the first man to strike one down would get?

answers.text: He would marry the king's daughter
He would get a city of his own

questions.question: After David became king and took Jerusalem, why did he become greater and greater?

answers.text: The LORD of Hosts was with him
The wealth of the nations was with him
The strength of his army was with him
